2bec78a6b1aec4638e9446cdefd7ca0961d0a195.sourceText: 虽然任务是自动驾驶，但方法思想非常容易迁移到移动机器人：
2bec78a6b1aec4638e9446cdefd7ca0961d0a195.translatedText: Although the task is autonomous driving, the methodology is very easy to transfer to mobile robots:

2bf9ff44e956b24bf9701f2e766e99c384815eed.sourceText: 实车到位后，先观察0.5 m过滤后是否仍有明显车体干扰、近处有效结构是否不足，再决定是否调整。当前没有这些实测证据，先保持0.5。
2bf9ff44e956b24bf9701f2e766e99c384815eed.translatedText: After the real vehicle is in place, first observe whether there is still obvious vehicle body interference after 0\.5 m filtering and whether nearby valid structures are insufficient, then decide whether to adjust\. Currently there is no such measured evidence, so keep 0\.5 for now\.
